label: Beginner
top_pain: No steady lead flow; prospecting is manual
looks: ChatGPT only or nothing. Work lives in their head. Unsure what an agent or AI operating system is.
needs: Hands-on setup: one paid AI account, one project with their context, one working prompt in session 1. Highest refund risk for 6 Nov.

label: Casual
top_pain: No steady lead flow; prospecting is manual
top_success: Time back: no longer the bottleneck
looks: Uses one to three chat tools for drafting and research some days. No saved workflows, no automations.
needs: A first agent built live with them, step by step. They know chat; they have never made it repeatable or scheduled.

label: Practitioner
top_pain: No steady lead flow; prospecting is manual
looks: Several tools used on purpose, Claude projects or custom GPTs, light automation. Projects tracked somewhere.
needs: Turn the prompts they already reuse into a scheduled agent with a review step. Clean up overlapping tools first.

label: Builder
top_pain: No steady lead flow; prospecting is manual
looks: Already builds automations or agents. Connected stack. Problems are reliability, scheduling and handoffs.
needs: Stretch work: scheduling, QA checks, connecting tools, multi-agent handoffs. Use them as breakout leads so they stay engaged.

label: Advanced
looks: Ships agents in production that run on schedules and could teach others.
needs: Nobody is here yet. This is the end state the program points to: agents running reliably without the founder.
